name: Standardization & Formulation
description: A separator splits warm milk into skim and cream, and in-line control remixes just enough cream to hit 3.5% fat.
tourCaption: Raw milk waits cold in the silos, then a separator splits it into skim and cream.
Just enough cream goes back in to make 3.5% milk.

name: Preheating & Deaeration
description: Heat exchangers warm the cold feed to about 80 °C, then a vacuum vessel strips out the air.
tourCaption: The milk is preheated to about 80 °C.
A vacuum vessel then boils off the air, which would foul the heaters.

name: Homogenization
description: A high-pressure piston pump forces milk through a narrow gap, so fat globules shrink below 1 µm and no cream layer forms.
tourCaption: Three pistons push the milk through a gap at 200 bar.
The fat globules shrink, so no cream layer forms on the shelf.

name: UHT Treatment
description: Steam heats the milk to about 140 °C, a holding tube keeps it there for about 4 s, and a drop below the divert limit sends it to reject.
tourCaption: Steam heats the milk to 140 °C for about 4 seconds.
If it runs too cool, the valve sends it to the reject tank.

name: Flash Cooling
description: A vacuum vessel drops the milk from about 140 °C to about 80 °C almost at once, then a cooler takes it to 20 °C.
tourCaption: In the flash vessel the milk falls back to about 80 °C at once.
A tubular cooler then brings it down to 20 °C.

name: Aseptic Storage (Buffer)
description: A sterile tank sits between the UHT plant and the fillers, so either side can stop without stopping the other.
tourCaption: The sterile tank is the buffer between liquid and packs.
Either side can stop for a while without stopping the other.

name: Aseptic Packaging
description: The fillers sterilize the carton material, form it into a tube, fill it with sterile milk and seal each pack below the liquid level.
tourCaption: Two fillers form, fill and seal 1-litre cartons in a sterile zone.
From here on, milk is counted in packs.

name: Secondary Packaging & Palletization
description: Conveyors group packs into shrink-wrapped trays, and a palletizer stacks the trays into labelled pallets.
tourCaption: Packs are grouped into trays of 12 and shrink-wrapped.
A robot stacks 84 trays on each labelled pallet.

name: Quarantine & QA Testing
description: Every batch stays on hold until its sample packs pass incubation, so a pallet can be finished but not yet sellable.
tourCaption: Every batch waits here while its samples incubate for 7 days.
Only batches that pass are released for sale.

name: Warehousing & Ambient Distribution
description: Released pallets are stored and shipped at room temperature, oldest best-before date first.
tourCaption: Released pallets wait in the racks at room temperature.
Trucks of 22 pallets leave every 100 minutes.
